language.name: English
plugin.description: Identifies comics on Comic Vine (metadata, covers and Claude) and tags them.
progress.cancelHint: Stops the search. The books that were not identified with enough certainty are offered for manual review.
progress.stopping: Stopping... the books that were not sure enough will be offered for review.
manual.title: Comic Vine AI - {0}
manual.tooltip:
Mouse wheel: zoom
Drag: move the page
Double click: fit to the window
Page Up / Page Down: previous / next page
manual.found: {0} series found. Click one to see its cover, double click (or the button) to see its issues.
settings.title: Comic Vine AI - Settings
settings.preferOriginal: Prefer the original publication (identify localized reprints and use the original issue)
settings.localPublishers: Unwanted publishers: their series are skipped (one per line)
settings.preferIndividual: Prefer individual issues over collected editions (TPB, hardcover, omnibus)
settings.coverComparison: Compare the first page with the Comic Vine covers
settings.skipScraped: Skip books that were already scraped
settings.useClaude: Ask the Claude CLI to identify the cover when the search fails (the cover image is sent to Claude)
batch.notSure: {0}: not sure enough, left for the end ({1})
batch.interruptedStatus: Stopped while working on this book. You can finish it by hand.
batch.counters: Tagged {0}    To review {1}    Skipped {2}        Comic Vine this run: {3} ({4} from the cache)        last hour: {5}
batch.stoppedByUser: Stopped by the user. {0} book(s) were not processed.
batch.summaryDone: Done: {0} tagged, {1} skipped, {2} left to review. Comic Vine calls: {3}; {4} answered by the cache.
batch.summaryStopped: Stopped: {0} tagged, {1} not processed. Comic Vine calls: {2}; {3} answered by the cache.
batch.limitStop: {0}: Comic Vine does not accept more calls for now. The search stops here; the book is left for manual review.
id.askingClaude: Asking Claude to identify the cover...
claude.notFound: The claude executable was not found. Set its path in the plugin settings.
claude.timeout: The Claude CLI did not answer in time.
claude.noJson: Claude did not answer with JSON: {0}
claude.parseError: Could not read the answer of Claude: {0} - {1}
cv.noKey: No Comic Vine API key. Set it in the plugin settings.
cv.refusing: Comic Vine keeps refusing the calls to '{0}' (hourly limit of {1}). Try again later.
cv.refused: Comic Vine refused the call: the hourly limit of '{0}' is reached ({1} by this plugin). Waiting {2} min...
cv.waitBudget: Comic Vine allows {0} calls per hour for '{1}' and {2} were used. Waiting {3} (cancel to stop).
settings.ignoreBlanks: Never replace an existing value with an empty one
settings.convertImprints: Convert imprints to their parent publisher (Vertigo becomes DC Comics plus the imprint)
settings.keyInTags: Add the Comic Vine key (CVDB<id>) to the Tags
settings.keyInNotes: Add "Scraped metadata from ComicVine [CVDB<id>]" to the Notes
settings.noteDate: Include the date in that note
settings.aliases: Publisher aliases (one per line: name --> alias)
settings.imprints: Custom imprints (one per line: imprint --> publisher)
id.claudeCached: Claude answer remembered from an earlier run (same cover)
